title: Motion Prefix Meanings
description: Systematic coverage of all motion prefixes
intro: Russian motion verb prefixes each carry a specific directional meaning. Learn them systematically: В- (into), ВЫ- (out of), ПРИ- (arrival), У- (departure), ПОД- (approach), ОТ- (away from), ЗА- (behind/drop by), ПЕРЕ- (across), ПРО- (through/past), ОБ- (around), ВЗ-/ВС- (up), С- (down). These prefixes combine with any motion verb base, so learning them once applies to идти/ходить, ехать/ездить, лететь/летать, and more.
rules: В-/ВО- = into: войти (enter), въехать (drive in), влететь (fly in)
ВЫ- = out of: выйти (exit), выехать (drive out), вылететь (fly out)
ПРИ- = arrival: прийти (arrive on foot), приехать (arrive by transport), прилететь (fly in/arrive)
У- = departure (away): уйти (leave), уехать (leave by transport), улететь (fly away)
examples: Он вошёл в комнату и вышел через пять минут. (He entered the room and left after five minutes.)
Самолёт прилетел в Москву и улетит завтра. (The plane arrived in Moscow and will fly out tomorrow.)
Подойди ко мне! Не отходи далеко! (Come up to me! Don't go far away!)
Мы перешли через улицу. (We crossed the street.)

items.prompt: Птица _____ в окно. (The bird flew into the window.)
items.promptEnglish: The bird flew into the window.

items.prompt: Автобус _____ из города в 6 утра. (The bus leaves the city at 6 AM.)
items.promptEnglish: The bus leaves the city at 6 AM.

items.prompt: Когда _____ поезд? (When does the train arrive?)
Она _____ от стола и подошла к окну. (She moved away from the table and went up to the window.)
items.promptEnglish: She moved away from the table and went up to the window.

items.prompt: Можно я _____ к вам? (May I come up to you?)
items.promptEnglish: May I come up to you?

items.prompt: По дороге я _____ в магазин. (On the way I dropped by the store.)
items.promptEnglish: On the way I dropped by the store.

items.prompt: Мы _____ через мост и повернули налево. (We crossed the bridge and turned left.)
items.promptEnglish: We crossed the bridge and turned left.

items.prompt: Машина _____ мимо нас. (The car drove past us.)
Туристы _____ весь город за день. (The tourists went around the whole city in a day.)
items.promptEnglish: The tourists went around the whole city in a day.

blanks: Самолёт _____ к земле. (The plane descended toward the ground.)
Он быстро _____ в комнату. (He quickly entered the room.)
Машина медленно _____ через мост. (The car slowly crossed the bridge.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Prefix meanings: с- = down; в- = into; пере- = across
hints: с- = downward motion. The plane goes down. Which verb?
в- = entering. He enters a room. Which verb?
пере- = across/through. The car crosses the bridge. Which verb?
explanations: The prefix с-/сни- indicates downward motion: снизился (descended).
The prefix в- indicates entering: вошёл (entered).
The prefix пере- indicates crossing: переехала (crossed over).
